messages.subject: International Mining Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Pender & Howe Team,

Your executive-search work across mining and resource leadership is strongly relevant to my background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where mining growth depends on strong institutional relationships, regulatory discipline and responsible development. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
